verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ በደብረ ፡ ሲና ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the mount Sina, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the mount Sina, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
translations.ron: Grăit-a Domnul cu Moise pe Muntele Sinai şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινᾷ, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ንግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፡ አመ ፡ ቦእክሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ አነ ፡ እሁበክሙ ፡ ወታዐርፍ ፡
                  [ምድር ፡] እንተ ፡ አነ ፡ እሁበክሙ ፡ ወታሰነብት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whensoever ye shall have entered into the land, which I give to you, then the land shall rest which I give to you, for its sabbaths to the Lord.

translations.lxx: Speak to the children of Israel, and thou shalt say to them, Whensoever ye shall have entered into the land, which I give to you, then the land shall rest which I give to you, for its sabbaths to the Lord.
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
translations.ron: "Vorbeşte fiilor lui Israel şi le spune: După ce veri intra în pământul pe care îl voi da vouă, să se odihnească pământul; să fie o odihnă în cinstea Domnului.
translations.grk: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ὅταν εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν γῆν, ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν, καὶ ἀναπαύσεται ἡ γῆ, ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν, σάββατα τῷ Κυρίῳ.

verses.geez: ስድስተ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ትዘርእ ፡ ገራህተከ ፡ ወስድስተ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ትገምድ ፡ ወይነከ ፡ ወታስተጋብእ ፡ ፍሬሁ ።
verses.translation: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vine, and gather in its fruit.

translations.lxx: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vine, and gather in its fruit.
translations.kjv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
translations.ron: şase ani să semeni ogorul tău, şase ani să lucrezi via ta şi să aduni roadele lor;
translations.grk: Ἓξ ἔτη σπερεῖς τὸν ἀγρόν σου, καὶ ἓξ ἔτη τεμεῖς τὴν ἄμπελόν σου, καὶ συνάξεις τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወበሳብዕ ፡ ዓም ፡ ሰንበ[ት] ፡ ዕረፍት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ወታሰነብት ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፤ ገራህተከኒ ፡ ኢትዘርእ ፡
                  ወዐጸደ ፡ ወይንከኒ ፡ ኢትገምድ ።
verses.translation: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath, it shall be a rest to the land, a sabbath to the Lord: thou shalt not sow thy field, and thou shalt not prune thy vine.

translations.lxx: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath, it shall be a rest to the land, a sabbath to the Lord: thou shalt not sow thy field, and thou shalt not prune thy vine.
translations.kjv: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
translations.ron: Iar anul al şaptelea să fie an de odihnă a pământului, odihna Domnului; ogorul tău să nu-l semeni şi via ta să n-o tai în anul acela.
translations.grk: Τῷ δὲ ἔτει τῷ ἑβδόμῳ σάββατα· ἀνάπαυσις ἔσται τῇ γῇ, σάββατα τῷ Κυρίῳ· τὸν ἀγρόν σου οὐ σπερεῖς, καὶ τὴν ἄμπελόν σου οὐ τεμεῖς,

verses.geez:
ወዘለሊሁኒ ፡ ይበቍል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገራህትከ ፡ ኢተዐፅድ ፡ ወአስካለኒ ፡ ዘቅዱስ ፡ ኢትቀሥም ፡ ዘይእቲ ፡ ዓመት ፡ እስመ
                  ፡ ዕረፍታ ፡ ለምድር ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt not gather the spontaneous produce of thy field, and thou shalt not gather fully the grapes of thy dedication: it shall be a year of rest to the land.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt not gather the spontaneous produce of thy field, and thou shalt not gather fully the grapes of thy dedication: it shall be a year of rest to the land.
translations.kjv: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
translations.ron: Ceea ce va creşte de la sine pe ogorul tău să nu seceri şi strugurii de pe viţele tale netăiate să nu-i culegi, ca să fie acest an de odihnă pentru pământ.
translations.grk: καὶ τὰ αὐτόματα ἀναβαίνοντα τοῦ ἀγροῦ σου οὐκ ἐκθερίσεις, καἰ τὴν σταφυλὴν τοῦ ἁγιάσματός σου οὐκ ἐκτρυγήσεις· ἐνιαυτὸς ἀναπαύσεως ἔσται τῇ γῇ.

verses.geez:
ወይኩን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘሰንበታ ፡ ለምድር ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለገብርከ ፡ ወለአመትከ ፡ ወለገባኢከ ፡ ወለፈላሲኒ ፡
                  ዘየኀድር ፡ ኀቤከ ፤
verses.translation: And the sabbaths of the land shall be food for thee, and for thy man-servant, and for thy maid-servant, and thy hireling, and the stranger that abides with thee.

translations.lxx: And the sabbaths of the land shall be food for thee, and for thy man-servant, and for thy maid-servant, and thy hireling, and the stranger that abides with thee.
translations.kjv: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
translations.ron: Şi aceste roade vor fi în timpul odihnei pământului hrană pentru tine, pentru robul tău şi pentru roaba ta, pentru simbriaşul tău şi pentru străinul tău care s-a aşezat la tine;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται τὰ σάββατα τῆς γῆς βρώματά σοι, καὶ τῷ παιδί σου, καὶ τῇ παιδίσκῃ σου, καὶ τῷ μισθωτῷ σου, καὶ τῷ παροίκῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ πρὸς σέ.

verses.geez: ወለእንስሳከ ፡ ወለአራዊተ ፡ ምድርከኒ ፡ ይኩንክሙ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እክሉ ።
verses.translation: And for thy cattle, and for the wild beasts that are in thy land, shall every fruit of it be for food.

translations.lxx: And for thy cattle, and for the wild beasts that are in thy land, shall every fruit of it be for food.
translations.kjv: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
translations.ron: Pentru dobitocul tău şi pentru fiarele cele de pe pământul tău, să fie de hrană toate roadele lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς κτήνεσί σου, καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τοῖς ἐν τῇ γῇ σου ἔσται πᾶν τὸ γέννημα αὐτοῦ εἰς βρῶσιν.

verses.geez:
ወትኌልቍ ፡ ለከ ፡ ሰብዐተ ፡ ዕረፍተ ፡ ዘሰብዐቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዘምስብዒት ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ትሬሲ ፡ ለከ ፡ ፯ሰናብተ ፡ በዘ
                  ፡ ትዜንዉ ፡ በመጥቅዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ በበ፵ወ፱ዓመት ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt reckon to thyself seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and they shall be to thee seven weeks of years, nine and forty years.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt reckon to thyself seven sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and they shall be to thee seven weeks of years, nine and forty years.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
translations.ron: Să numeri apoi şapte ani de odihnă, adică de şapte ori câte şapte ani, ca să ai în cei de şapte ori câte şapte ani, patruzeci şi nouă de ani.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξαριθμήσεις σεαυτῷ ἑπτὰ ἀναπαύσεις ἐτῶν, ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἑπτάκις· καὶ ἔσονταί σοι ἑπτὰ ἑβδομάδες ἐτῶν ἐννέα καὶ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη.

verses.geez: ወበሳብዕ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ አስተ[ስር]ዮ ፡ ትዜንዉ ፡ በመጥቅዕ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድርክሙ ።
verses.translation: In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall make a proclamation with the sound of a trumpet in all your land; on the day of atonement ye shall make a proclamation with a trumpet in all your land.

translations.lxx: In the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall make a proclamation with the sound of a trumpet in all your land; on the day of atonement ye shall make a proclamation with a trumpet in all your land.
translations.kjv: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
translations.ron: Şi să trâmbiţezi cu trâmbiţa în luna a şaptea, în ziua a zecea a lunii; în ziua curăţirii să trâmbiţezi cu trâmbiţa în toată ţara voastră.
translations.grk: Διαγγελεῖτε σάλπιγγος φωνῇ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνός· τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ ἱλασμοῦ διαγγελεῖτε σάλπιγγι ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወቀድስዋ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ዓመት ፡ [ዘ፶ ፡] ኵላ ፡ ዓመታ ፡ ወስብኩ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡
                  እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወተአምረ ፡ ይኩንክሙ ፡ ወይእቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጥሪቱ
                  ፡ ወይሑር ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገሩ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall sanctify the year, the fiftieth year, and ye shall proclaim a release upon the land to all that inhabit it; it shall be given a year of release, a jubilee for you; and each one shall depart to his possession, and ye shall go each to his family.

translations.lxx: And ye shall sanctify the year, the fiftieth year, and ye shall proclaim a release upon the land to all that inhabit it; it shall be given a year of release, a jubilee for you; and each one shall depart to his possession, and ye shall go each to his family.
translations.kjv: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
translations.ron: Să sfinţiţi anul al cincizecilea şi să se vestească slobozenie pe pământul vostru pentru toţi locuitorii lui. Să vă fie acesta an de slobozenie, ca să se întoarcă fiecare la moşia sa; fiecare să se întoarcă la ogorul său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἁγιάσετε τὸ ἔτος τὸν πεντηκοστὸν ἐνιαυτὸν, καὶ διαβοήσετε ἄφεσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πᾶσι τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν αὐτήν· ἐνιαυτὸς ἀφέσεως σημασία αὕτη ἔσται ὑμῖν· καὶ ἀπελεύσεται εἷς ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κτῆσιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν πατριὰν αὐτοῦ ἀπελεύσεσθε.

verses.geez:
ትእምርተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ (ወ)ይኩንክሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዘኀምሳ ፡ ኵላ ፡ ዓመታ ፡ ኢትዘርኡ ፡ ወኢተዐፅዱ ፡ እንበለ ፡
                  ዘለሊሁ ፡ በቍለ ፡ ወኢትቀሥሙ ፡ ዘተቀደሰ ፡ ባቲ ።
verses.translation: This is a jubilee of release, the year shall be to you the fiftieth year: ye shall not sow, nor reap the produce that comes of itself from the land, neither shall ye gather its dedicated fruits.

translations.lxx: This is a jubilee of release, the year shall be to you the fiftieth year: ye shall not sow, nor reap the produce that comes of itself from the land, neither shall ye gather its dedicated fruits.
translations.kjv: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
translations.ron: Anul al cincizecilea să vă fie an de slobozenie: să nu semănaţi, nici să seceraţi ceea ce va creşte de la sine pe pământ, şi să nu culegeţi poama de pe viţele netăiate,
translations.grk: Ἀφέσεως σημασία αὕτη, τὸ ἔτος τὸ πεντηκοστὸν ἐνιαυτὸς ἔσται ὑμῖν· οὐ σπερεῖτε, οὐδὲ ἀμήσετε τὰ αὐτόματα ἀναβαίνοντα αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐ τρυγήσετε τὰ ἡγιασμένα αὐτῆς,

verses.geez: እስመ ፡ ትእምርተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወቅዱሰ ፡ ይኩንክሙ ፡ ወብልዑ ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ እክል ።
verses.translation: For it is a jubilee of release; it shall be holy to you, ye shall eat its fruits off the fields.

translations.lxx: For it is a jubilee of release; it shall be holy to you, ye shall eat its fruits off the fields.
translations.kjv: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
translations.ron: Că acesta e jubileu; sfânt să fie pentru voi; roadele de pe ogor să le mâncaţi.
translations.grk: ὅτι ἀφέσεως σημασία ἐστίν· ἅγιον ἔσται ὑμῖν· ἀπὸ τῶν πεδίων φάγεσθε τὰ γεννήματα αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወበይእቲ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዘትእምርተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ የአቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጥሪቱ ።
verses.translation: In the year of the release even the jubilee of it, shall each one return to his possession.

translations.lxx: In the year of the release even the jubilee of it, shall each one return to his possession.
translations.kjv: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
translations.ron: În anul jubileu să se întoarcă fiecare la moşia sa.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῆς ἀφέσεως σημασίας αὐτῆς ἐπανελεύσεται εἰς τὴν ἔγκτησιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ ፡ ቦ ፡ ዘሤጠ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ካልኡ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ ቦ ፡ ዘተሣየጠ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ካልኡ ፡ ኢያጽኅቦ ፡ ለካልኡ ።
verses.translation: And if thou shouldest sell a possession to thy neighbour, or if thou shouldest buy of thy neighbour, let not a man oppress his neighbour.

translations.lxx: And if thou shouldest sell a possession to thy neighbour, or if thou shouldest buy of thy neighbour, let not a man oppress his neighbour.
translations.kjv: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
translations.ron: De vei vinde ceva aproapelui tău sau de vei cumpăra ceva de la aproapele tău, să nu înşele nimeni pe aproapele său.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἀποδῷ πράσιν τῷ πλησίον σου, ἐὰν δὲ καὶ κτήσῃ παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου, μὴ θλιβέτω ἄνθρωπος τὸν πλησίον.

verses.geez: እምድኅረ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ትእምርት ፡ ይሠይጥ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ ወበመዋዕለ ፡ ይዘራእ ፡ እክል ፡ በውእቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ይፈድየከ ።
verses.translation: According to the number of years after the jubilee shalt thou buy of thy neighbour, according to the number of years of the fruits shall he sell to thee.

translations.lxx: According to the number of years after the jubilee shalt thou buy of thy neighbour, according to the number of years of the fruits shall he sell to thee.
translations.kjv: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
translations.ron: După numărul anilor trecuţi de la cel din urmă jubileu să cumperi de la aproapele tău, şi după numărul anilor de cules să-ţi vândă el.
translations.grk: Κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἐτῶν μετὰ τὴν σημασίαν κτήσῃ παρὰ τοῦ πλησίον, κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ἐνιαυτῶν γεννημάτων ἀποδώσεταί σοι.

verses.geez:
በአምጣነ ፡ ብዝኆሙ ፡ ለእማንቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ያበዝኅ ፡ ጥሪቶ ፡ ወአመ ፡ ይትኀደጉ ፡ ውእቶሙ ፡ ዓመት ፡ የኀድግ ፡
                  ተሣይጦ ፡ ወበመዋዕለ ፡ ይዘራእ ፡ እክል ፡ ይፈድየከ ።
verses.translation: According as there may be a greater number of years he shall increase the value of his possession, and according as there may be a less number of years he shall lessen the value of his possession; for according to the number of his crops, so shall he sell to thee.

translations.lxx: According as there may be a greater number of years he shall increase the value of his possession, and according as there may be a less number of years he shall lessen the value of his possession; for according to the number of his crops, so shall he sell to thee.
translations.kjv: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
translations.ron: Dacă au rămas ani mai mulţi până la jubileu, sporeşte preţul, iar dacă au rămas puţini ani, micşorează preţul, căci un anumit număr de secerişuri îţi vinde el.
translations.grk: Καθότι ἂν πλεῖον τῶν ἐτῶν πληθυνεῖ τὴν ἔγκτησιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ καθότι ἂν ἔλαττον τῶν ἐτῶν ἐλαττονώσει τὴν ἔγκτησιν αὐτοῦ· ὅτι ἀριθμὸν γεννημάτων αὐτοῦ, οὕτως ἀποδώσεταί σοι.

verses.geez: ወኢያጽኅብ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ ወፍራህ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: Let not a man oppress his neighbour, and thou shalt fear the Lord thy God: I am the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: Let not a man oppress his neighbour, and thou shalt fear the Lord thy God: I am the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the LORD your God.
translations.ron: Să nu înşele nimeni pe aproapele său; teme-te de Domnul Dumnezeul tău; Eu sunt Domnul Dumnezeul vostru.
translations.grk: Μὴ θλιβέτω ἄνθρωπος τὸν πλησίον· καὶ φοβηθήσῃ Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου· ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὑμῶν.

verses.geez: ወግበሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ኵነኔየ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ፍትሕየ ፡ ወዕቀብዎ ፡ ወግበርዎ ፡ ወትነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ ተአሚነክሙ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall keep all my ordinances, and all my judgments; and do ye observe them, and ye shall keep them, and dwell securely in the land.

translations.lxx: And ye shall keep all my ordinances, and all my judgments; and do ye observe them, and ye shall keep them, and dwell securely in the land.
translations.kjv: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
translations.ron: Faceţi poruncile Mele şi toate hotărârile Mele; faceţi şi păziţi toate acestea şi veţi locui liniştiţi pe pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ ποιήσετε πάντα τὰ δικαιώματά μου, καὶ πάσας τὰς κρίσεις μου, καὶ φυλάξασθε, καὶ ποιήσετε αὐτὰ, καὶ κατοικήσετε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πεποιθότες.

verses.geez: ወትሁበክሙ ፡ ምድር ፡ ፍሬሃ ፡ ወትበልዑ ፡ ወትጸግቡ ፡ ወትነብሩ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትትአመኑ ።
verses.translation: And the land shall yield her increase, and ye shall eat to fulness, and shall dwell securely in it.

translations.lxx: And the land shall yield her increase, and ye shall eat to fulness, and shall dwell securely in it.
translations.kjv: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
translations.ron: Pământul îşi va da rodul său, veţi mânca până la saţ şi veţi trăi liniştiţi pe el.
translations.grk: Καὶ δώσει ἡ γῆ τὰ ἐκφόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ φάγεσθε εἰς πλησμονὴν, καὶ κατοικήσετε πεποιθότες ἐπʼ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ትብሉ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ንበልዕ ፡ በውእቱ ፡ ሳብዕ ፡ ዓም ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኢዘራእነ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ኢያስተጋባእነ ፡
                  እክለነ ፤
verses.translation: And if ye should say, What shall we eat in this seventh year, if we do not sow nor gather in our fruits?

translations.lxx: And if ye should say, What shall we eat in this seventh year, if we do not sow nor gather in our fruits?
translations.kjv: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
translations.ron: Iar de veţi zice: Dar ce să mâncăm în anul al şaptelea, când nici nu vom semăna, nici nu vom aduna roadele noastre?
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ λέγητε, τί φαγόμεθα ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἑβδόμῳ τούτῳ, ἐὰν μὴ σπείρωμεν μηδὲ συναγάγωμεν τὰ γεννήματα ἡμῶν;

verses.geez: እፌኑ ፡ በረከትየ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ አመ ፡ ሳድስ ፡ ዓም ፡ ወትገብር ፡ ፍሬሃ ፡ ዘሠለስቱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ እክል ።
verses.translation: Then will I send my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and the land shall produce its fruits for three years.

translations.lxx: Then will I send my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and the land shall produce its fruits for three years.
translations.kjv: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
translations.ron: Vă voi trimite binecuvântarea Mea în anul al şaselea şi va aduce roadele sale pentru trei ani.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποστέλλω τὴν εὐλογίαν μου ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ ἕκτῳ, καὶ ποιήσει τὰ γεννήματα αὐτῆς εἰς τὰ τρία ἔτη.

verses.geez:
ወትዘርኡ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ በሳምንኒ ፡ ዓም ፡ ወትበልዑ ፡ እምውእቱ ፡ እክል ፡ ከራሚ ፡ እስከ ፡ ታስዕ ፡ ዓም ፡ እስከ ፡
                  አመ ፡ ይበጽሕ ፡ እክላ ፡ ትበልዑ ፡ ብሉየ ፡ ከራሜ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall sow in the eighth year, and eat old fruits till the ninth year: until its fruit come, ye shall eat old fruits of the old.

translations.lxx: And ye shall sow in the eighth year, and eat old fruits till the ninth year: until its fruit come, ye shall eat old fruits of the old.
translations.kjv: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
translations.ron: Şi veţi semăna în anul al optulea, dar de mâncat veţi mânca roadele cele vechi până la al nouălea an: până se vor coace roadele anului al optulea veţi mânca din cele vechi din anii trecuţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ σπερεῖτε τὸ ἔτος τὸ ὄγδοον, καὶ φάγεσθε ἀπὸ τῶν γεννημάτων παλαιὰ ἕως τοῦ ἔτους τοῦ ἐνάτου· ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ τὸ γέννημα αὐτῆς, φάγεσθε παλαιὰ παλαιῶν.

verses.geez:
ወምድርኒ ፡ ኢትሠየጥ ፡ ስሉጠ ፡ እስመ ፡ እንቲአየ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወእስመ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ግዩራነ ፡ ወፈላስያነ ፡
                  ኮንክሙ ፡ ቅድሜየ ።
verses.translation: And the land shall not be sold for a permanence; for the land is mine, because ye are strangers and sojourners before me.

translations.lxx: And the land shall not be sold for a permanence; for the land is mine, because ye are strangers and sojourners before me.
translations.kjv: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
translations.ron: Pământul să nu-l vindeţi de veci, că pământul este al Meu; iar voi sunteţi străini şi venetici înaintea Mea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ γῆ οὐ πραθήσεται εἰς βεβαίωσιν· ἐμὴ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ γῆ, διότι προσήλυτοι καὶ πάροικοι ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐναντίον μου.

verses.geez: ወበኵሉ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምኵናነ ፡ ዘዚአክሙ ፡ ታቤዝዉ ፡ ምድረ ።
verses.translation: And in every land of your possession, ye shall allow ransoms for the land.

translations.lxx: And in every land of your possession, ye shall allow ransoms for the land.
translations.kjv: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
translations.ron: În toate părţile stăpânirii voastre să îngăduiţi răscumpărarea pământului.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατὰ πᾶσαν γῆν κατασχέσεως ὑμῶν, λύτρα δώσετε τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez:
ለእመ ፡ ነደየ ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ዘምስሌከ ፡ ወሤጠከ ፡ ምድሮ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ዘቅሩቡ ፡ ዘይኰስዮ ፡ ታቤዝዎ ፡ ዘሤጠ
                  ፡ እኁሁ ።
verses.translation: And if thy brother who is with thee be poor, and should have sold part of his possession, and his kinsman who is nigh to him come, then he shall redeem the possession which his brother has sold.

translations.lxx: And if thy brother who is with thee be poor, and should have sold part of his possession, and his kinsman who is nigh to him come, then he shall redeem the possession which his brother has sold.
translations.kjv: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
translations.ron: Dacă fratele tău, care e cu tine, va sărăci şi va vinde din moştenirea sa, să vină ruda sa de aproape şi să cumpere ceea ce vinde fratele său.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ πένηται ὁ ἀδελφός σου ὁ μετὰ σοῦ, καὶ ἀποδῶται ἀπὸ τῆς κατασχέσεως αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλθῃ ὁ ἀγχιστεύων ὁ ἐγγίζων αὐτῷ, καὶ λυτρώσεται τὴν πρᾶσιν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ዘይኰስዮ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ ረከበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወአእከለ ፡ ለቤዝወቱ ፤
verses.translation: And if one have no near kinsman, and he prosper with his hand, and he find sufficient money, even his ransom;

translations.lxx: And if one have no near kinsman, and he prosper with his hand, and he find sufficient money, even his ransom;
translations.kjv: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
translations.ron: Dacă însă nu va avea cineva rudenie, ci îi va da lui mâna şi va găsi cât îi trebuie pentru răscumpărare,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ᾖ τινι ὁ ἀγχιστεύων, καὶ εὐπορηθῇ τῇ χειρὶ, καὶ εὑρεθῇ αὐτῷ τὸ ἱκανὸν, λύτρα αὐτοῦ·

verses.geez:
ወይኌልቁ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ዘእምአመ ፡ ሤጠ ፡ ወይፈድዮ ፡ በመጠነ ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘኀቤሁ ፡ ሤጠ ፡
                  ወይገብእ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ገራህቱ ።
verses.translation: then shall he calculate the years of his sale, and he shall give what is due to the man to whom he sold it, and he shall return to his possession.

translations.lxx: then shall he calculate the years of his sale, and he shall give what is due to the man to whom he sold it, and he shall return to his possession.
translations.kjv: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
translations.ron: Atunci să numere anii vânzării sale, şi ce trece să întoarcă aceluia, căruia i-a vândut, şi se va întoarce la moşia sa.
translations.grk: καὶ συλλογιεῖται τὰ ἔτη τῆς πράσεως αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀποδώσει ὅ ὑπερέχει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ, ᾧ ἀπέδοτο αὐτὸ αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀπελεύσεται εἰς τὴν κατάσχεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ኢረከበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ በአምጣነ ፡ ይፈድዮ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ገራህቱ ፡ ለዘተሣየጦ ፡ እስከ ፡ አመ ፡ ዓመተ
                  ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ወየሐውር ፡ በዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ወያገብእ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ገራህቶ ።
verses.translation: But if his hand have not prospered sufficiently, so as that he should restore the money to him, then he that bought the possessions shall have them till the sixth year of the release; and it shall go out in the release, and the owner shall return to his possession.

translations.lxx: But if his hand have not prospered sufficiently, so as that he should restore the money to him, then he that bought the possessions shall have them till the sixth year of the release; and it shall go out in the release, and the owner shall return to his possession.
translations.kjv: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
translations.ron: Iar dacă nu va găsi mâna lui cit îi trebuie să întoarcă aceluia, atunci pământul vândut de el va rămâne în mâinile cumpărătorului până la anul jubileu, şi în anul jubileu cumpărătorul va ieşi şi vânzătorul va intra în stăpânirea sa.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εὑπορηθῇ αὐτοῦ ἡ χεὶρ τὸ ἱκανὸν, ὥστε ἀποδοῦναι αὐτῷ, καὶ ἔσται ἡ πράσις τῷ κτησαμένῳ αὐτὰ ἕως τοῦ ἕκτου ἔτους τῆς ἀφέσεως, καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἐν τῇ ἀφέσει, καὶ ἀπελεύσεται εἰς τὴν κατάσχεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወለእመቦ ፡ ዘሤጠ ፡ ቤቶ ፡ ወበውስተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ቅጽረ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይፌጽም ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዓመት
                  ፡ ይከውኖ ፡ ለቤዝዎ ፡ ወያቤዝውዎ ።
verses.translation: And if any one should sell an inhabited house in a walled city, then there shall be the ransom of it, until the time is fulfilled: its time of ransom shall be a full year.

translations.lxx: And if any one should sell an inhabited house in a walled city, then there shall be the ransom of it, until the time is fulfilled: its time of ransom shall be a full year.
translations.kjv: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
translations.ron: De va vinde cineva casă de locuit în oraş îngrădit cu zid, poate s-o răscumpere până într-un an de la vânzarea ei: timp de un an poate s-o răscumpere.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δέ τις ἀποδῶται οἰκίαν οἰκητὴν ἐν πόλει τετειχισμένῃ, καὶ ἔσται ἡ λύτρωσις αὐτῆς, ἕως πληρωθῇ· ἐνιαυτὸς ἡμερῶν ἔσται ἡ λύτρωσις αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ተፈጸመት ፡ ኵላ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወኢቤዘወ ፡ ስሉጠ ፡ ይከውኖ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቤት ፡ ለዘተሣየጠ ፡ ወየሐትትዎ
                  ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ውእተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ቅጽረ ፡ ወይከውኖ ፡ ለውሉዶ ፡ ውሉዱ ፡ ወኢይነሥእዎ
                  ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ አመ ፡ ተኀድጎ ።
verses.translation: And if it be not ransomed until there be completed of its time a full year, the house which is in the walled city shall be surely confirmed to him that bought it, throughout his generations; and it shall not go out in the release.

translations.lxx: And if it be not ransomed until there be completed of its time a full year, the house which is in the walled city shall be surely confirmed to him that bought it, throughout his generations; and it shall not go out in the release.
translations.kjv: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
translations.ron: Iar de nu se va răscumpăra până la împlinirea unui an întreg, casa cea din oraş îngrădit cu zid va rămâne pentru totdeauna aceluia care a cumpărat-o şi urmaşilor lui, şi în anul jubileu nu va trece de la el.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ μὴ λυτρωθῇ ἕως ἂν πληρωθῇ αὐτῆς ἐνιαυτὸς ὅλος, κυρωθήσεται ἡ οἰκία ἡ οὖσα ἐν πόλει τῇ ἐχούσῃ τεῖχος, βεβαίως τῷ κτησαμένῳ αὐτὴν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσεται ἐν τῇ ἀφέσει.

verses.geez:
ወአብያተሰ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ እንተ ፡ አልባቲ ፡ ቅጽረ ፡ ዐውዳ ፡ ከመ ፡ ገራህተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ይትቤዘዉ ፡ ወበኵሉ ፡
                  ጊዜ ፡ ያቤዝውዎ ፡ ወአመ ፡ ተኀድጎኒ ፡ ያገብእዎ ።
verses.translation: But the houses in the villages which have not a wall round about them, shall be reckoned as the fields of the country: they shall always be redeemable, and they shall go out in the release.

translations.lxx: But the houses in the villages which have not a wall round about them, shall be reckoned as the fields of the country: they shall always be redeemable, and they shall go out in the release.
translations.kjv: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
translations.ron: Iar casele din sate, care n-au împrejur zid, să se socotească deopotrivă cu pământul: ele se pot răscumpăra oricând şi în anul jubileu trec la fostul lor stăpân.
translations.grk: Αἱ δὲ οἰκίαι αἱ ἐν ἐπαύλεσιν, αἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐταῖς τεῖχος κύκλῳ, πρὸς τὸν ἀγρὸν τῆς γῆς λογισθήσονται· λυτρωταὶ διαπαντὸς ἔσονται, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀφέσει ἐξελεύσονται.

verses.geez: ወአህጉረ ፡ ሌዋውያንኒ ፡ ይትቤዘዉ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ወያቤዝውዎሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ።
verses.translation: And the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities in their possession, shall be always redeemable to the Levites.

translations.lxx: And the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities in their possession, shall be always redeemable to the Levites.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
translations.ron: Cât pentru oraşele leviţilor şi casele din oraşele stăpânirii lor, leviţii le vor putea răscumpăra de-a pururi.
translations.grk: Καὶ αἱ πόλεις τῶν Λευιτῶν, οἰκίαι τῶν πόλεων κατασχέσεως αὐτῶν, λυτρωταὶ διαπαντὸς ἔσονται τοῖς Λευίταις.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ዘተቤዘወ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ አብያት ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ዘገብአ ፡ ለአብዕልቲሁ ፡ ተሠይጦ
                  ፡ ዘአግብኡ ፡ አመ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ በደወለ ፡ ዚአሆሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ውእቱ ፡ [ምኵናን] ፡
                  ዘዚአሆሙ ፡ ይኩን ፡ በማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And if any one shall redeem a house of the Levites, then shall their sale of the houses of their possession go out in the release; because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: And if any one shall redeem a house of the Levites, then shall their sale of the houses of their possession go out in the release; because the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Iar dacă cineva din leviţi nu va face răscumpărarea, atunci casa vândută din oraşele stăpânirii lor se întoarce în anul jubileu, căci casele din oraşele leviţilor sunt stăpânirea lor între fiii lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὃς ἂν λυτρώσηται παρὰ τῶν Λευιτῶν, καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἡ διάπρασις αὐτῶν οἰκιῶν πόλεως κατασχέσεως αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ἀφέσει, ὅτι οἰκίαι τῶν πόλεων τῶν Λευιτῶν κατάσχεσις αὐτῶν ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወገራውህኒ ፡ ዘደወለ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ኢይሠየጥ ፡ እስመ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘለዓለም ።
verses.translation: And the lands set apart for their cities shall not be sold, because this is their perpetual possession.

translations.lxx: And the lands set apart for their cities shall not be sold, because this is their perpetual possession.
translations.kjv: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
translations.ron: Nici ogoarele dimprejurul oraşelor lor nu se pot vinde, pentru că acestea sunt moştenirea lor veşnică.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ ἀγροὶ ἀφωρισμένοι ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν οὐ πραθήσονται, ὅτι κατάσχεσις αἰωνία τοῦτο αὐτῶν ἐστον.

verses.geez:
ወእመኒ ፡ ነደየ ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ዘምስሌከ ፡ ወስእነ ፡ ተገብሮ ፡ በኀቤከ ፡ ተዐቅቦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ግዩር ፡ ወፈላስ ፡ ወየሐዩ
                  ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ምስሌከ ።
verses.translation: And if thy brother who is with thee become poor, and he fail in resources with thee, thou shalt help him as a stranger and a sojourner, and thy brother shall live with thee.

translations.lxx: And if thy brother who is with thee become poor, and he fail in resources with thee, thou shalt help him as a stranger and a sojourner, and thy brother shall live with thee.
translations.kjv: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
translations.ron: Dacă fratele tău va sărăci şi va ajunge la strâmtorare înaintea ta, ajută-l, fie străin, fie băştinaş, ca să trăiască cu tine.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ πένηται ὁ ἀδελφός σοῦ ὁ μετὰ σοῦ, καὶ ἀδυνατήσῃ ταῖς χερσὶ παρὰ σοὺ, ἀντιλήψῃ αὐτοῦ ὡς προσηλύτου καὶ παροίκου, καὶ ζήσεται ὁ ἀδελφός σου μετὰ σοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወኢትንሣእ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ርዴ ፡ ወኢእመ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አጐንደየ ፡ ወፍራህ ፡ አምላክከ ፡ እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ወይሕየው ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ምስሌከ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not receive from him interest, nor increase: and thou shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord: and thy brother shall live with thee.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not receive from him interest, nor increase: and thou shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord: and thy brother shall live with thee.
translations.kjv: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
translations.ron: Să nu iei de la el dobândă şi spor, ci să te temi de Dumnezeul tău, ca să trăiască fratele tău cu tine. Eu sunt Domnul.
translations.grk: Οὐ λήψῃ παρʼ αὐτοῦ τόκον, οὐδὲ ἐπὶ πλήθει· καὶ φοβηθήσῃ τὸν Θεόν σου· ἐγὼ Κύριος· καὶ ζήσεται ὁ ἀδελφός σου μετὰ σοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢትሁቦ ፡ ወርቀከ ፡ በርዴ ፡ ወ[እክለከኒ] ፡ ኢትትረደዮ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not lend thy money to him at interest, and thou shalt not lend thy meat to him to be returned with increase.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not lend thy money to him at interest, and thou shalt not lend thy meat to him to be returned with increase.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
translations.ron: Argintul tău să nu ţi-l dai lui cu camătă şi pâinea ta să nu i-o dai ca s-o iei cu spor.
translations.grk: Τὸ ἀργύριόν σου οὐ δώσεις αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τὸκῳ, καὶ ἐπὶ πλεονασμῷ οὐ δώσεις αὐτῷ τὰ βρώματά σου.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ አነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘአውፃእኩክሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሀብክሙ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ከናአን ፡
                  ወእኩንክሙ ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Chanaan, so as to be your God.

translations.lxx: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Chanaan, so as to be your God.
translations.kjv: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
translations.ron: Eu sunt Domnul Dumnezeul vostru, Cel ce v-am scos din pământul Egiptului, ca să vă dau pământul Canaanului şi ca să fiu Dumnezeul vostru.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὑμῶν, ὁ ἐξαγαγὼν ὑμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, δοῦναι ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν Χαναὰν, ὥστε εἶναι ὑμῶν Θεός.

verses.geez: ወእመ ፡ ተፀነሰ ፡ ካልእከ ፡ ወተሠይጠ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ኢይትቀነይ ፡ ለከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ገብር ።
verses.translation: And if thy brother by thee be lowered, and be sold to thee, he shall not serve thee with the servitude of a slave.

translations.lxx: And if thy brother by thee be lowered, and be sold to thee, he shall not serve thee with the servitude of a slave.
translations.kjv: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
translations.ron: Când îi va sărăci fratele şi-i se va vinde ţie, să nu-l pui la muncă de rob,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ταπεινωθῇ ὁ ἀδελφός σου παρὰ σοὶ, καὶ πραθῇ σοι, οὐ δουλεύσει σοι δουλείαν οἰκέτου.

verses.geez: አላ ፡ ከመ ፡ ገባኢ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ፈላሲ ፡ ይኩንከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ይትቀነይ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: He shall be with thee as a hireling or a sojourner, he shall work for thee till the year of release:

translations.lxx: He shall be with thee as a hireling or a sojourner, he shall work for thee till the year of release:
translations.kjv: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
translations.ron: Ci să fie el la tine ca simbriaş sau străin, şi să-ţi lucreze până la anul jubileu;
translations.grk: Ὡς μισθωτὸς ἢ πάροικος ἔσται σοι· ἕως τοῦ ἔτους τῆς ἀφέσεως ἐργᾶται παρὰ σοί,

verses.geez:
ወአመ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወይገብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዝማዲሁ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ደወሉ
                  ፡ ወየሐውር ፡ ብሔሮ ።
verses.translation: and he shall go out in the release, and his children with him; and he shall go to his family, he shall hasten back to his patrimony.

translations.lxx: and he shall go out in the release, and his children with him; and he shall go to his family, he shall hasten back to his patrimony.
translations.kjv: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
translations.ron: Iar atunci să se ducă de la tine, şi el şi copiii lui împreună cu el, să se întoarcă în neamul său şi să intre iarăşi în stăpânirea părinţilor săi.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται τῇ ἀφέσει, καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀπελεύσεται εἰς τὴν γενεὰν αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὴν κατάσχεσιν τὴν πατρικὴν ἀποδραμεῖται.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ እለ ፡ አውፃእኩ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፤ ኢይሠየጡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሠየጥ ፡
                  ገብር ።
verses.translation: Because these are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; such an one shall not be sold as a common servant.

translations.lxx: Because these are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; such an one shall not be sold as a common servant.
translations.kjv: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
translations.ron: Pentru că ei sunt robii Mei, pe care Eu i-am scos din pământul Egiptului;
translations.grk: Διότι οἰκέται μου εἰσὶν οὗτοι, οὓς ἐξήγαγον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου· οὐ πραθήσεται ἐν πράσει οἰκέτου.

verses.geez: ወኢ[ታ]ጠውቆ ፡ በጻማ ፡ ወፍራህ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not oppress him with labour, and shalt fear the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not oppress him with labour, and shalt fear the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
translations.ron: Să nu-i vinzi, cum se vând robii, să nu-i stăpâneşti cu cruzime şi să te temi de Dumnezeul tău.
translations.grk: Οὐ κατατενεῖς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ μόχθῳ, καὶ φοβηθήσῃ Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου,

verses.geez:
ወገብረሰ ፡ ወአመተኒ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ረከብከ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ዐውድክሙ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ታጠርዩ ፡ ገብረኒ ፡
                  ወአመተኒ ።
verses.translation: And whatever number of men-servants and maid-servants thou shalt have, thou shalt purchase male and female servants from the nations that are round about thee.

translations.lxx: And whatever number of men-servants and maid-servants thou shalt have, thou shalt purchase male and female servants from the nations that are round about thee.
translations.kjv: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
translations.ron: Iar ca să-ti ai robul tău şi roaba ta, să-ti cumperi rob şi roabă de la neamurile dimprejurul vostru.
translations.grk: καὶ παῖς καὶ παιδίσκη ὅσοι ἂν γένωνταί σοι, ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ὅσοι κύκλῳ σου εἰσὶν, ἀπʼ αὐτῶν κτήσεσθε δοῦλον καὶ δούλην,

verses.geez:
ወእምውስተ ፡ ደቂቆሙኒ ፡ ለእለ ፡ የኀድሩ ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ታጠርዩ ፡ ወእምውስተ ፡ አዝማዲሆሙኒ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡
                  እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድርክሙ ፡ ለጥሪትክሙ ፡ ይኩኑክሙ ።
verses.translation: And of the sons of the sojourners that are among you, of these ye shall buy and of their relations, all that shall be in your lands; let them be to you for a possession.

translations.lxx: And of the sons of the sojourners that are among you, of these ye shall buy and of their relations, all that shall be in your lands; let them be to you for a possession.
translations.kjv: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
translations.ron: Puteţi să vă cumpăraţi şi din copiii străinilor, care s-au aşezat la voi, şi din neamul lor, care este la voi şi care s-a născut în pământul vostru; pot să fie averea voastră.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν παροίκων τῶν ὄντων ἐν ὑμῖν, ἀπὸ τούτων κτήσεσθε καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν συγγενῶν αὐτῶν, ὅσοι ἂν γένωνται ἐν τῇ γῇ ὑμῶν, ἔστωσαν ὑμῖν εἰς κατάσχεσιν.

verses.geez:
ወለውሉድክሙኒ ፡ እምውስቴቶሙ ፡ ተከፈልዎሙ ፡ ወይኩኑክሙ ፡ ለጥሪትክሙ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወለዘ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አኀዊከ ፡
                  ዘእምደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ኢያጥቆ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ በጻማ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall distribute them to your children after you, and they shall be to you permanent possessions for ever: but of your brethren the children of Israel, one shall not oppress his brother in labours.

translations.lxx: And ye shall distribute them to your children after you, and they shall be to you permanent possessions for ever: but of your brethren the children of Israel, one shall not oppress his brother in labours.
translations.kjv: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
translations.ron: Puteţi să-i daţi moştenire fiilor voştri după voi, ca orice avere, veşnic să-i stăpâniţi, ca pe robi. Iar asupra fraţilor voştri din fiii lui Israel şi unul asupra altuia, să nu domniţi cu cruzime.
translations.grk: Καὶ καταμεριεῖτε αὐτοὺς τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν μεθʼ ὑμᾶς· καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν κατόχιμοι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· τῶν δὲ ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ οὐ κατατενεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς μόχθοις.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ረከበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ግዩር ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ፈላስ ፡ ዘኀቤከ ፡ ወይቤለከ ፡ ሰብአቲሁ ፡
                  አቤዝወኒዮ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ግዩር ፡ አው ፡ ለዝክቱ ፡ ፈላስ ፡ ዘኀቤከ ፤
verses.translation: And if a stranger or sojourner with thee wax rich, and thy brother in distress be sold to the stranger or the sojourner that is with thee, or to a proselyte by extraction;

translations.lxx: And if a stranger or sojourner with thee wax rich, and thy brother in distress be sold to the stranger or the sojourner that is with thee, or to a proselyte by extraction;
translations.kjv: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
translations.ron: Dacă străinul sau veneticul tău s-a îmbogăţit pe lângă tine, iar fratele tău a sărăcit lângă tine şi s-a vândut veneticului, care s-a aşezat la tine, sau unui urmaş din neamul veneticului,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ εὕρῃ ἡ χεὶρ τοὺ προσηλύτου ἢ τοῦ παροίκου τοῦ παρὰ σοὶ, καὶ ἀπορηθεὶς ὁ ἀδελφός σου πραθῇ τῷ προσηλύτῳ ἢ τῷ παροίκῳ τῷ παρὰ σοὶ, ἢ ἐκ γενετῆς προσηλύτῳ,

verses.geez:
እምድኅረ ፡ ተሣየጥካሆሙ ፡ እመኒ ፡ ዘሰብአቲሁ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ግዩር ፡ ታቤዝዎ ፡ ወይቤዝዎ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምውስተ ፡
                  ሰብአቲሁ ፤
verses.translation: after he is sold to him there shall be redemption for him, one of his brethren shall redeem him.

translations.lxx: after he is sold to him there shall be redemption for him, one of his brethren shall redeem him.
translations.kjv: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
translations.ron: Atunci, după vânzare, se va putea răscumpăra; careva din fraţii lui va putea să-l răscumpere:
translations.grk: μετὰ τὸ πραθῆναι αὐτῷ, λύτρωσις ἔσται αὐτοῦ· εἷς τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ λυτρώσεται αὐτόν.

verses.geez:
እመኒ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አኀወ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ይቤዝውዎ ፡ አው ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ሰብአቲሁ
                  ፡ አው ፡ እምነ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ አው ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ነገዱ ፡ ይቤዝዎ ፡ ወለእመሰ ፡ ረከበ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ይቤዙ ፡
                  ርእሶ ።
verses.translation: A brother of his father, or son of his father's brother shall redeem him; or let one of his near kin of his tribe redeem him, and if he should be rich and redeem himself,

translations.lxx: A brother of his father, or son of his father's brother shall redeem him; or let one of his near kin of his tribe redeem him, and if he should be rich and redeem himself,
translations.kjv: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
translations.ron: Sau unchiul lui, sau fiul unchiului va putea să-l răscumpere, sau careva din neamul lui, din seminţia lui să-l răscumpere; sau de va avea îndestulare, să se răscumpere singur.
translations.grk: Ἀδελφὸς πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀδελφοῦ πατρὸς λυτρώσεται αὐτόν, ἢ ἀπὸ τῶν οἰκείων τῶν σαρκῶν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς αὐτοῦ λυτρῶται αὐτόν· ἐὰν δὲ εὐπορηθεὶς ταῖς χερσὶ λυτρῶται ἑαυτὸν,

verses.geez:
ወየሐስቡ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ለዘተሣየጦ ፡ እምዓመት ፡ ዘተሣየጦ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ወይሬስዩ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ሤጦ
                  ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘዕለቱ ፡ ለገባኢ ፡ ዘእምዓመት ፡ እስከ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.translation: then shall he calculate with his purchaser from the year that he sold himself to him until the year of release: and the money of his purchase shall be as that of a hireling, he shall be with him from year to year.

translations.lxx: then shall he calculate with his purchaser from the year that he sold himself to him until the year of release: and the money of his purchase shall be as that of a hireling, he shall be with him from year to year.
translations.kjv: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
translations.ron: Şi acela să se răfuiască cu cel ce l-a cumpărat, de la anul când s-a vândut el până la anul jubileu, şi argintul pentru care s-a vândut să i-l întoarcă după numărul anilor; socotindu-i ca slujiţi de un simbriaş vremelnic la el.
translations.grk: καὶ συλλογιεῖται πρὸς τὸν κεκτημένον αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔτους οὗ ἀπέδοτο ἑαυτὸν αὐτῷ ἕως τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ τῆς ἀφέσεως· καὶ ἔσται τὸ ἀργύριον τῆς πράσεως αὐτοῦ ὡς μισθίου· ἔτος ἐξ ἔτους ἔσται μετʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመ ፡ ወሰከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሰማንቱ ፡ ዓም ፡ ይሁብ ፡ ቤዛሁ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ወርቀ ፡ ሤጡ ።
verses.translation: And if any have a greater number of years than enough, according to these he shall pay his ransom out of his purchase-money.

translations.lxx: And if any have a greater number of years than enough, according to these he shall pay his ransom out of his purchase-money.
translations.kjv: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
translations.ron: Şi dacă rămân încă mulţi ani, el va plăti răscumpărarea potrivit anilor acestora, după preţul cu care a fost cumpărat.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δέ τινι πλεῖον τῶν ἐτῶν ᾖ, πρὸς ταῦτα ἀποδώσει τὰ λύτρα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀργυρίου τῆς πράσεως αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመሰ ፡ ሕዳጥ ፡ ተርፈ ፡ ዓመት ፡ እስከ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ የኀስቡ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ዓመቲሁ ፡ ወይሁብ ፡ ቤዛሁ ፤
verses.translation: And if but a little time be left of the years to the year of release, then shall he reckon to him according to his years, and shall pay his ransom

translations.lxx: And if but a little time be left of the years to the year of release, then shall he reckon to him according to his years, and shall pay his ransom
translations.kjv: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
translations.ron: Iar dacă rămân puţini ani până la anul jubileu, să-i numere şi să plătească, pentru răscumpărarea sa, după numărul anilor.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ὀλίγον καταλειφθῇ ἀπὸ τῶν ἐτῶν εἰς τὸν ἐνιαυτὸν τῆς ἀφέσεως, καὶ συλλογιεῖται αὐτῷ κατὰ τὰ ἔτη αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀποδώσει τὰ λύτρα αὐτοῦ ὡς μισθωτός·

verses.geez:
ከመ ፡ ዐስበ ፡ ገባኢ ፡ ዘእምዓመት ፡ እስከ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ዘለለ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ዘጻመወ ፡ ሎቱ
                  ፡ በቅድሜሁ ።
verses.translation: as a hireling; he shall be with him from year to year; thou shalt not oppress him with labour before thee.

translations.lxx: as a hireling; he shall be with him from year to year; thou shalt not oppress him with labour before thee.
translations.kjv: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
translations.ron: El să fie la dânsul cu anul, ca simbriaşul, şi acela să nu-l stăpânească cu asprime înaintea ochilor tăi.
translations.grk: ἐνιαυτὸς ἐξ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἔσται μετʼ αὐτοῦ· οὐ κατατενεῖς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ μόχθῳ ἐνώπιόν σου.

verses.geez: ወእመሰ ፡ ኢተቤዘወ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ አመ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ተኀድጎ ፡ ይወፅእ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቁ ።
verses.translation: And if he do not pay his ransom accordingly, he shall go out in the year of his release, he and his children with him.

translations.lxx: And if he do not pay his ransom accordingly, he shall go out in the year of his release, he and his children with him.
translations.kjv: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
translations.ron: Iar dacă el nu se va răscumpăra în chipul acesta, atunci în anul jubileu va ieşi el însuşi, şi împreună cu el, şi copiii lui,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ μὴ λυτρῶται κατὰ ταῦτα, ἐξελεύσεται ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῆς ἀφέσεως αὐτὸς καὶ τὰ παιδία αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እል ፡ አውፃእኩ ፡ እምነ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወአነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
                  ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: For the children of Israel are my servants: they are my attendants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt.

translations.lxx: For the children of Israel are my servants: they are my attendants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
translations.ron: Pentru că fiii lui Israel sunt robii Mei; robii Mei sunt ei, că Eu i-am scos din pământul Egiptului. Eu sunt Domnul Dumnezeul vostru.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐμοὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ οἰκέται εἰσὶ, παῖδές μου οὗτοί εἰσιν, οὓς ἐξήγαγον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου.
